Northern Segment
This is the northern ring segment.  Exits are clockwise and counterclockwise.  

> clockwise
You move east.

Eastern Segment
This is the eastern ring segment.  Exits are clockwise and counterclockwise.

> cw
You move east.

Southern Segment
This is the southern ring segment.  Exits are clockwise and counterclockwise.

> cw
You move east.

Western Segment
This is the western ring segment.  Exits are clockwise and counterclockwise.

> cw
You move east.

Northern Segment
This is the northern ring segment.  Exits are clockwise and counterclockwise.

> ccw
You move west.

Western Segment
This is the western ring segment.  Exits are clockwise and counterclockwise.
